notes: Colophon names no person: only the text-end formula (tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ of the Anekārthadhvanimañjarī), the anonymous scribal disclaimer 'yādṛśī pustakaṃ dṛṣṭvā tādṛśī likhitaṃ mayā ... mama doṣo na dīyate', 'rāma rāma rāma', and a stock subhāṣita on good and bad men (jīmūta/phaṇin verse). No date in the quoted colophon; the catalogue's 'SAM 1799' (probably VS 1799 = c. 1742 CE, Devanagari ms.) must come from elsewhere in the manuscript. '(9)3' and '(1)' are line/folio markers, not a date.
